title: Couronne d'éclipse
style: Soft painterly stadium diorama, original design: no text, logos, ball emblems or recognisable venue. Crowd as a soft colour mass. Values one to two steps darker than the pixel-art creatures, calm and low-contrast behind them (stands band and landmark base), detail and the brightest accents kept to the upper sky and the edges.
plate: A black sun inside a blazing pink-gold corona over a rose dusk horizon; a ring of dark crown spires with rose rim light encircles the stadium. Dark stone galleries with rose-gold trims, spire lamps.
court: Polished dark rose marble with soft gold veining, a sun-ring inlay around the centre, amber markings and an inlaid six-rhombus sigil.
value: Dark disc with a bright ring at the top centre, bright pink lower sky, dark spires.
